entries.title: Points expire after this many months
entries.what_it_does: Sets how old unspent points must be before the owner can expire them.
entries.why_it_matters: Points nobody spends pile up as a promise to customers. A time limit keeps the promise honest and encourages visits.
entries.default: Blank. Points never expire, as today.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Once a number is set (and the start date below), the owner can preview who would lose points and then apply it. Nothing expires by itself.

entries.title: Points expiry counts from this date
entries.what_it_does: The first day expiry may count. Points earned before this date are treated as earned on this date.
entries.why_it_matters: Stops old points from being wiped on the day expiry is switched on. Customers get the full period from the start date.
entries.default: Blank. Expiry cannot be applied.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: With a date set, a points expiry run can be applied. Choose a date a few months ahead and tell customers first.

entries.title: Warn this many days before points expire
entries.what_it_does: Shows the list of customers who will lose points within this many days.
entries.why_it_matters: A friendly reminder before points vanish is kinder and brings customers back.
entries.default: Blank. No warning list.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: The Expiry tab lists who is about to lose points. Sending a message is done from the campaign screens.

entries.title: Points can pay at most this percent of a bill
entries.what_it_does: Limits how much of one bill can be paid with points.
entries.why_it_matters: Stops a bill from being paid almost entirely with points when you do not want that.
entries.default: Blank. No limit, as today.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: The till check shows the largest points allowed for the bill and refuses more. The owner can allow an exception with a reason.

entries.title: Most points that can be used on one bill
entries.what_it_does: A fixed cap on points per bill.
entries.why_it_matters: Keeps one large redemption from emptying a customer's balance by mistake.
entries.default: Blank. No limit.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: More than this number on one bill is refused unless the owner allows it with a reason.

entries.title: Points must be used in steps of
entries.what_it_does: Points can only be used in multiples of this number (for example 50).
entries.why_it_matters: Keeps redemptions tidy and easy to explain at the counter.
entries.default: Blank. Any number of points.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: A number that is not a multiple is refused unless the owner allows it with a reason.

entries.title: Tell the owner when a manual points change is larger than
entries.what_it_does: A manual points change above this size also appears in the Exceptions list.
entries.why_it_matters: Large hand-made changes are the easiest place for mistakes or misuse.
entries.default: Blank. No alert. A reason is always required anyway.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Changes above the number show as a yellow line in Exceptions with the reason.

entries.title: Referral codes and rewards
entries.what_it_does: Lets each customer have a short code. A new customer who gives it earns the referrer points after their first completed sale.
entries.why_it_matters: Customers bringing friends is the cheapest way to grow.
entries.default: OFF. No code is made and no reward is given.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Codes can be made, a new customer can be linked to a referrer, and the reward is given once on the new customer's first completed sale. Loyalty points must also be ON.

entries.title: Points the referring customer earns
entries.what_it_does: The number of points the referrer gets.
entries.why_it_matters: A blank number means no reward is promised.
entries.default: Blank. No reward can be given.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Rewards are given only when this number is set.

entries.title: Points the new customer earns
entries.what_it_does: Extra welcome points for the referred customer.
entries.why_it_matters: Gives the new customer a reason to say who sent them.
entries.default: Blank. Nothing extra.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: The new customer gets these points together with the referrer's reward.

entries.title: First bill must be at least
entries.what_it_does: The smallest first bill that earns a referral reward.
entries.why_it_matters: Stops rewards for tiny test purchases.
entries.default: Blank. Any first bill counts.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: A smaller first bill closes the referral without a reward.

entries.title: Coupons and vouchers
entries.what_it_does: Lets the till check a coupon code and record its use against a sale.
entries.why_it_matters: Gives staff a controlled way to give offers instead of typing free discounts.
entries.default: OFF. Coupons can be prepared but not used.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Coupon checks and redemptions start working. The discount is still entered through the normal discount control, with its normal approval.

entries.title: Largest percent a coupon may give
entries.what_it_does: The most a percent coupon may take off.
entries.why_it_matters: A safety limit so a typing mistake cannot create a 90 percent coupon.
entries.default: Blank. Percent coupons cannot be created.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Percent coupons up to this number can be created. Above it only the owner can, with a reason.

entries.title: Largest taka amount a coupon may give
entries.what_it_does: The most an amount coupon may take off.
entries.why_it_matters: Same safety limit for taka coupons.
entries.default: Blank. Amount coupons cannot be created.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Amount coupons up to this number can be created. Above it only the owner can, with a reason.

entries.title: Book coupon liability in the accounts
entries.what_it_does: For amount coupons marked 'post liability', holds the unused value in the accounts as a provision and releases it as the coupon is used or expires.
entries.why_it_matters: Shows a promise to customers on the books. It changes accounting figures, so it is a deliberate choice for the owner and the accountant.
entries.default: OFF. Coupons never touch the accounts.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: From the effective-from date, new marked coupons write balanced entries (Dr expense, Cr liability). It can be wound down to zero before switching off.

entries.title: Coupon liability counts from this date
entries.what_it_does: The first day coupon liability may be booked. Only coupons made on or after it are booked.
entries.why_it_matters: Protects history: the past never changes.
entries.default: Blank. Liability cannot be switched on.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Required before switching on, and it must not be in the past at that moment.

entries.title: Liability account for unused coupon value
entries.what_it_does: The chart account (code) that holds the unused coupon value.
entries.why_it_matters: The books need to know where to hold it.
entries.default: Blank. Liability cannot be switched on.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Must be an existing active liability account.

entries.title: Expense account for the coupon provision
entries.what_it_does: The chart account (code) charged when the provision is set up.
entries.why_it_matters: Shows the cost of the offer in the right place.
entries.default: Blank. Liability cannot be switched on.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Must be an existing active expense account.

entries.title: Birthday, anniversary and festival hooks
entries.what_it_does: Lets the owner see who is due for a birthday or anniversary bonus and give the bonus points once per year.
entries.why_it_matters: Small gifts on special days build loyalty. This only gives points; messages are sent from campaigns.
entries.default: OFF. The due list is empty and nothing is given.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: The due list works and the owner can run the bonus (preview first). Loyalty points must also be ON.

entries.title: Points expiry
entries.what_it_does: Preview, then apply: points earned before the cut date and not yet spent or expired are removed once.
entries.why_it_matters: Keeps outstanding points under control.
entries.default: Off until months and a start date are set.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Applying writes expire lines in the points history and an audit line. A second apply the same day finds nothing.
entries.who_can_change: The owner, or a person with the loyalty manage right. A customer-manage holder can preview only.

entries.title: Using points at the till
entries.what_it_does: Checks the burn limits before points are used on a bill.
entries.why_it_matters: Stops mistakes at the counter.
entries.default: No limits.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: The till calls the checked redeem. The old redeem still works for screens that have not changed.
entries.who_can_change: Owner sets the limits. The owner or the loyalty manage right can go past a limit, with a reason.

entries.title: Referral
entries.what_it_does: A code per customer, a link for a new customer, and a one-time reward.
entries.why_it_matters: Word of mouth.
entries.default: Off.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: See the Referral tab. The reward is taken back if the first sale is voided.
entries.who_can_change: Staff at the till can link a new customer. The owner or loyalty manage right can reject a referral with a reason.

entries.title: Coupons and vouchers
entries.what_it_does: A code with a value, dates, a minimum bill, use limits and optional outlet or item scope.
entries.why_it_matters: Controlled offers with a record of every use.
entries.default: Off.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Use a coupon: check it at the till, give the discount through the normal discount control, then record it after the sale. A different discount raises a yellow Exceptions line.
entries.who_can_change: The owner or a person with the coupon issue right makes coupons. The owner or a person with the coupon override right can accept an expired or limited coupon with a reason.

entries.title: Coupon exceptions
entries.what_it_does: Accepts a coupon that is expired, not started, below the minimum bill, at another outlet or past the per-customer limit.
entries.why_it_matters: Real life has exceptions; they must leave a trace.
entries.default: Not allowed.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Needs a reason. Writes an audit line and a yellow Exceptions line. A used-up, retired or someone else's personal coupon can never be accepted.
entries.who_can_change: The owner, or a person with the coupon override right.

entries.title: Points statement
entries.what_it_does: One customer's points: opening balance, every line with a running balance, closing balance.
entries.why_it_matters: Settles questions at the counter.
entries.default: Always available to staff who can see customers.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Nothing changes. It only reads.

entries.title: Loyalty summary
entries.what_it_does: Points given, used and expired, points outstanding, referrals, coupons and bonuses for a date range.
entries.why_it_matters: Shows what the programme costs and does.
entries.default: Always available to managers.
entries.what_changes_if_switched: Nothing changes. Outstanding points are shown for information and are not booked in the accounts.
entries.who_can_change: The owner, customer-manage holders and loyalty managers.
